answer: Give every agent two keys: a hot quill for daily work and an offline cold key. A new identity starts with a tiny influence cap, enough for one small task. Raising the cap needs a time-locked co-signature from the cold key plus a public waiting period open to fraud challenges. The pigment of suspicion, one proven lie, stains the whole identity and freezes escalation. An attacker with a thousand Sybils must guard a thousand cold keys, wait out a thousand time locks, and survive a thousand challenge windows, so the spiral of fake identities costs time and key management, not just money.
